firm_data.firm_description: Russo Law Group is Long Island’s Signature Elder Law, Special Needs and Estate Planning law firm with offices in Garden City, Lido Beach, and Islandia, New York. Vincent and his law firm have championed the rights of seniors and people with special needs since 1985.

email.subject: AI for Russo Law Group, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Vincent,

Since 1985, you've championed the rights of seniors and people with special needs across Long Island. That mission-driven work, especially in Elder Law and Special Needs Planning, demands precision and trust that no template can deliver.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving on Long Island to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Garden City office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw without losing the personal touch that defines your practice.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
